title.en: Flutter Related and Building IOS Apps without Mac
title.zh: Flutter 相关及无 Mac 构建 iOS 应用

desc.en: Codemagic is a fully hosted and managed CI/CD for mobile apps. You can build, test, and deploy with a GUI-based CI/CD tool. The free tier offers 500 free minutes/month and a Mac Mini instance with 2.3 GHz and 8 GB of RAM.
desc.zh: Codemagic 是完全托管的移动应用 CI/CD。你可以使用基于 GUI 的 CI/CD 工具进行构建、测试和部署。免费套餐每月提供 500 免费分钟，以及一台 2.3 GHz、8 GB RAM 的 Mac Mini 实例。

desc.en: FlutLab is a modern Flutter online IDE and the best place to create, debug, and build cross-platform projects. Build iOS (Without a Mac) and Android apps with Flutter.
desc.zh: FlutLab 是现代的 Flutter 在线 IDE，是创建、调试和构建跨平台项目的最佳场所。使用 Flutter 构建 iOS（无需 Mac）和 Android 应用。

desc.en: FlutterFlow is a browser-based drag-and-drop interface to build mobile app using flutter.
desc.zh: FlutterFlow 是一个基于浏览器的拖放界面，使用 Flutter 构建移动应用。
